Application Materials.content:
Applicants must submit the following documents through the [Online Application System](https://www.gradsch.cuhk.edu.hk/OnlineApp/login_email.aspx) by the specified deadline:
- Academic/Professional Certificates: for all applicants, both graduation and professional qualification certificates. For degrees obtained from Chinese Mainland: both degree (學位證書) and graduation (畢業證書) certificates printed in Chinese; and valid Online Verification Reports of Higher Education Qualification Certificates (教育部學歷證書電子註冊備案表) and Degree Certificates (中國高等教育學位在線驗證報告) issued from CHESICC for Mainland China degrees.
- Official Transcripts and Grading Schemes: all copies of official transcripts and grading schemes with explanatory notes for all tertiary education. E-transcripts must be sent directly by the issuing university; paper transcripts must be in a sealed envelope issued by the university. Transcripts must bear official seal; unofficial or improper letterhead documents will not be accepted. Non-English/Chinese transcripts require certified English translation. CUHK graduates can submit photocopies of transcripts (excluding CUHK (Shenzhen)); the University reserves the right to require an original copy.
- **The University requires applicants to provide verification reports of the qualification obtained. Applicants will be notified by the Graduate Division concerned/Graduate School separately.**
- English Language Proficiency Requirements: submit one of the listed supporting documents, such as a Hong Kong university graduation certificate, a Registry certifying letter confirming English as the medium of instruction, an official TOEFL/IELTS/GMAT (Verbal) score report, specified Hong Kong examination English results, certified true copy of GCE A-level or AS-level/CUHK Matriculation English results, or certified true copy of a recognised professional qualification where the examination was in English.
- Confidential Recommendations: other programmes require **two referee reports**. Submit referee information via the [Online Application System](https://www.gradsch.cuhk.edu.hk/OnlineApp/login_email.aspx).
- Identification Documents: Hong Kong Identity Card or other identity document.
- Qualification Assessment (HKCAAVQ): degrees awarded by overseas universities by distance learning or by completing a curriculum of short duration may be required to provide [HKCAAVQ](https://www.hkcaavq.edu.hk/en/) assessment on the level of qualification obtained. Applicants will be notified by the Graduate Division concerned separately.
- Programme-Specific Materials: additional materials may be required for specific programmes.
- **Applicants will be required to complete an Authorisation Form for the University to verify their academic qualifications. The programme staff may further contact the applicants to proceed with applying for academic verification from a third-party organization, e.g., Chinese Service Center for Scholarly Exchange (CSCSE) as needed.**
- Submitted documents are non-returnable; materials from unsuccessful applications will be destroyed after the completion of the admission exercise.

Interview Requirements.content:
- Shortlisted applicants will be invited for an interview.
- If your application is successful, we will send you an offer letter via email within two months. If you do not hear from us by approximately two months after the interview, you may consider your application unsuccessful.
- Admission Scholarship is awarded based on academic achievements, interview performance, relevant professional experiences, personal qualities, and/or other outstanding merits.

Application Deadlines.content:
**Application Commencement Date\***: **1 September 2025 at 09:00 a.m. (Hong Kong time)**
MSc in Actuarial Science and Insurance Analytics: **1 August 2025 (Early Round)**; **31 March 2026**. Application will be processed on a rolling basis until all places have been filled. Therefore, early applications are strongly encouraged. The application may be closed early if places are no longer available. The subsequent applications received may not be considered.

Academic Requirements.content:
- Applicants must have **graduated from a recognised university and obtained a bachelor’s degree**, normally with honours not lower than **Second Class** or achieving an average grade of not lower than **“B”**; or completed a course of study in a tertiary educational institution and obtained professional or similar qualifications equivalent to a bachelor’s degree.
- In addition to the general requirements of the Graduate School, applicants should have **taken and passed at least one university-level course in either calculus, probability, statistics, or an approved equivalent course**.

GRE GMAT Requirements.content: GMAT / GRE scores are not mandatory, but a good GMAT / GRE score will strengthen the application.

English Proficiency Requirements.content:

- obtained a Degree from a university in Hong Kong* or taken a degree programme of which the medium of instruction was English; or
- achieved scores in any one of the following English Language tests** as indicated: **TOEFL: 79 of 120 / 4.5 of 6 (Internet-based/Home Edition); IELTS (Academic): 6.5 (Test Centre based / Online); GMAT: Band 21 (Verbal)#; GMAT Focus Edition: Band 78 (Verbal)**; or
- obtained a recognised professional## qualification, provided that the examination was conducted in English.
For more details, please go to the CUHK Graduate School website on the English Language Requirements for Admission [here](https://www.gs.cuhk.edu.hk/admissions/admissions/requirements).

Moreover, graduates from universities in Hong Kong should have fulfilled the English language requirements of the institution concerned when they were admitted to the degree programmes. Program Overview.content:
The MSc in Actuarial Science and Insurance Analytics (ASI) is a full-time master’s programme designed to nurture high-calibre actuaries to meet Asia’s growing demand. Built on the highly successful [BBA in Insurance, Financial and Actuarial Analysis (IFAA)](https://ifaa.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/) and augmented by the academic and career support of the CUHK Business School, the programme helps students develop adaptable skills for actuarial or analytical roles in insurance companies, banks, financial institutions, or InsurTech start-ups. Students are also primed for associate-level professional examinations administered by the Society of Actuaries (US), enabling them to practise across the world.
The MSc in ASI is Hong Kong’s only actuarial science master’s programme. Students study under a syllabus approved by the International Actuarial Association and gain regional insights into the insurance markets of Hong Kong and mainland China. They learn from locally and internationally qualified teachers and have opportunities to partake in fellowships in Hong Kong (with the Hong Kong Actuarial Society), Singapore, the US and the UK. The programme trains students to standards stipulated by leading actuarial bodies and can lead to globally recognised professional qualifications upon graduation.
MSc in ASI is a **Center of Actuarial Excellence (CAE)** designated by the **Society of Actuaries (SOA), USA**. The programme offers rigorous academic training for students aspiring to enter the actuarial profession and is specifically designed to prepare graduates for early actuarial professional examinations. The curriculum is fully aligned with SOA standards and covers associate level examination content. The programme has been awarded **University Earned Credit (UEC)** status by the SOA for **five preliminary examinations—FM, FAM, SRM, ALTAM, and ASTAM**—enabling students to earn internationally recognised credits and enter the profession well prepared upon graduation.
As Asia transforms into the world’s fastest-growing insurance market, ASI graduates will find prospects in diverse industries. In Hong Kong, actuaries have been identified by the government as a category of professionals urgently needed by the city, with the profession appearing on the Talent List of Hong Kong. In the Greater Bay Area (GBA), actuaries versed in international insurance practices and actuarial leadership roles are also highly sought after.
**Duration:** Full-time: 1 year
**Programme commencement:** September

Curriculum.content:
The MSc in Actuarial Science and Insurance Analytics (MScASI) is a **full-time** Master’s programme. Duration: **Full-time: 1 year**. The medium of instruction is **English**.
The MScASI curriculum is tailored for fresh graduates and junior professionals who want to obtain a solid foundation in insurance knowledge, actuarial science, mathematics and statistics skills. The curriculum is aligned to standards of professional bodies and covers the associate-level exam materials administered by the Society of Actuaries (SOA). The programme has received University-Earned Credit status from the SOA for five preliminary exams – FM, FAM, SRM, ALTAM and ASTAM.
To graduate from the programme, students need to complete **36 units of coursework**, including **10 core courses and 2 elective courses**. Core and elective courses are subject to change.
Full-time Programme (1 Year):
- Term 1 Sep-Dec: 4 core courses; 1 elective course
- Term 2 Dec-Mar: 3 core courses; 1-2 elective course(s)
- Term 3 Mar-Jun: 3 core courses; 1-2 elective course(s)
Core Courses (Total 10 Courses / 30 Units):
- [FINA6601 Economics for Actuaries](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscasi/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-1-0)
- [FINA6602 Accounting and Corporate Finance](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscasi/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-1-1)
- [FINA6603 Probability with Applications in Finance and Insurance](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscasi/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-1-2)
- [FINA6604 Financial Mathematics for Actuaries](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscasi/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-1-3)
- [FINA6605 Statistics for Risk Modelling](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscasi/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-1-4)
- [FINA6606 Actuarial Mathematics for Long-Term Insurance](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscasi/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-1-5)
- [FINA6607 Actuarial Mathematics for Short-Term Insurance](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscasi/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-1-6)
- [FINA6608 Derivatives for Actuaries](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscasi/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-1-7)
- [FINA6609 Data Science for Insurance Analytics](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscasi/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-1-8)
- [FINA6610 Statistical Modelling for Insurance Analytics](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscasi/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-1-9)
Elective Courses (Total 6 Units):
- [FINA6611 Insurance and Risk Management](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscasi/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-2-0)
- [FINA6612 Life Insurance](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscasi/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-2-1)
- [FINA6613 Commercial Property and Liability Insurance](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscasi/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-2-2)
- [FINA6616 Advanced Life Contingencies](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscasi/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-2-3)
- [FINA6617 Loss and Survival Models](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscasi/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-2-4)
Students may take up to **3 credits’ worth of courses** offered by the MAcc, MBA and other MSc programmes within CUHK Business School, subject to the approval of the programme directors.
Course Exemption: Exemptions may be granted for up to **2 core courses**. If a student is exempted from any of the selected core courses, they will be required to replace the units with other elective courses. An exemption may be granted if a student has completed an equivalent undergraduate-level course and obtained a grade of “B” or above, or if they have passed relevant professional exams from the SOA or IFoA.
Graduation Requirements: To graduate, students must complete the prescribed coursework and achieve a cumulative grade point average (GPA) of at least **2.50**. Students who receive a grade of D+ or below in a course must repeat it or take an approved substitute course.
Corresponding ASI courses for ASA requirements:
| ASA requirement | Corresponding ASI course(s) |
| --- | --- |
| VEE Micro + Macro Economics | FINA6601 |
| VEE Accounting and Finance | FINA6602 |
| VEE Mathematical Statistics | FINA6605 |
| Exam FM: Financial Mathematics | FINA6604 |
| Exam FAM-L: Fundamentals of Actuarial Math (Long-term) | FINA6606 |
| Exam FAM-S: Fundamentals of Actuarial Math (Short-term) | FINA6607 |
| Exam SRM: Statistics for Risk Modelling | FINA6609 FINA6610 |
| Exam ALTAM: Advanced Long-term Actuarial Math | FINA6608 FINA6616 |
| Exam ASTAM: Advanced Short-term Actuarial Math | FINA6617 |
| Exam P: Probability | FINA6603 |
| Exam PA: Predictive Analytics | FINA6609 FINA6610 |
University-Earned Credit (UEC) Program: The MSc in ASI programme is part of the UEC program approved by the SoA. Students can use university exemptions to earn credits for the following exams:
| SoA exam | ASI course(s) |
| --- | --- |
| Exam FM | FINA6604 |
| Exam FAM | FINA6606 + FINA6607 |
| Exam SRM | FINA6609 + FINA6610 |
| Exam ALTAM | FINA6616 + FINA6608 |
| Exam ASTAM | FINA6617 |
This is contingent upon achieving a score of **60 or above** in the corresponding course(s). Exam P and Exam PA cannot be exempted using university courses. For the three areas covered by Validation by Educational Experience, students can earn VEE credits by completing FINA 6601, 6602, and 6605, provided they achieve a grade of **B- or higher** in these courses.

Financial Aid.content:
#### Scholarships
We offer various scholarship opportunities each year to outstanding candidates based on academic achievements and personal accomplishments.
#### Admission Scholarship
Newly admitted students with outstanding entrance qualifications are eligible for this scholarship, which is awarded based on their academic achievements, interview performance, relevant professional experiences, personal qualities, and/or other outstanding merits.
#### Academic Performance Prize
This prize recognises top-achieving students of the programme. It will be awarded to the top 10 students attaining a final cumulative GPA of **3.6 or above** upon the completion of the programme.
#### The Hong Kong Federation of Insurers Graduate Scholarship
Sponsored by The Hong Kong Federation of Insurers, this scholarship is awarded to one outstanding local Hong Kong student to promote tertiary education in insurance. Eligible candidates will be nominated by the Programme and invited to attend a selection interview.

Multiple Applications.content:
You can apply for multiple programmes, but you must submit separate applications and pay the application fees for each programme. The paid application fee is non-refundable and non-transferable. If admitted to multiple programmes, you can only enrol in one. All fees paid to the previous programmes will not be refunded or transferred.
The application fee is **HK$500 per programme** (except for MBA, MBA in Finance and MSc in Finance).

Deferral Admission Policy.content:
You may contact your Graduate Division/Programme first to see if you could defer your admission date. If the deferral is allowed, please complete and return the "Application Form for Deferred Admission" available on the [Online Application System for Postgraduate Programmes](https://www.gradsch.cuhk.edu.hk/OnlineApp/login_email.aspx) to the relevant Division/Programme after accepting the admission offer online and making the deposit payment. The admission can be deferred for a maximum of **one year from the original admission date**.
You may contact your Graduate Division/Programme to see if your deferral request for acceptance of the admission offer and the deposit payment could be accepted. If it is accepted, you may complete and return the "Application Form for Deferred Acceptance of Admission Offer" at the [Online Application System for Postgraduate Programmes](https://www.gradsch.cuhk.edu.hk/OnlineApp/login_email.aspx) to the respective Division/Programme. Please note that the acceptance of an admission offer cannot be deferred beyond the admission date.

Conditional Admission Policy.content:
Final-year undergraduates can apply for postgraduate programmes admission. Please submit your latest official transcript. If accepted, provide an official final transcript and degree certificate upon admission.
If you have received an admission offer with condition(s), follow the steps in [How to Register](https://www.gs.cuhk.edu.hk/registration/how-to-register) for provisional registration. Your student status is not yet confirmed and you will **NOT** be allowed to begin your studies until you have fulfilled all the specified condition(s) and have your academic qualification verified by the deadline mentioned in the Admission Notification.
If you cannot provide document(s) to fulfil the admission condition(s) mentioned in the Admission Notification, your admission offer will be withdrawn. You are also required to have your academic qualifications verified before the admission date.
